info.title: Scrape Agent
info.description: Pay-per-use web scraping API built on x402. Extract clean text, links, HTML or metadata from any public URL for $0.01 USDC.
info.x-guidance: Call POST /api/scrape/x402 with a JSON body containing a URL and extract type. Pay $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base, Arc, or Polygon. Input: url (string, required), extract (text|html|links|meta, default: text). Output: JSON with url, extract, result, statusCode. Use this when you need clean text or structured data from any public webpage. No API key or account required.

post.summary: Scrape any public URL and return clean content
post.description: Extract text, links, HTML or metadata from any public URL. Requires $0.01 USDC payment via x402 on Base, Arc or Polygon. Returns 402 without valid X-PAYMENT header.

extract.description: What to extract: text (clean readable text), html (raw HTML), links (all href URLs), meta (title and description)

example.result: Example Domain. This domain is for use in illustrative examples.

402.description: Payment required. Include X-PAYMENT header with valid x402 USDC payment on Base (eip155:8453), Arc (eip155:421614), or Polygon (eip155:137).

400.description: Bad request — url field is required

500.description: Scrape failed — target URL may be unavailable

get.description: GET returns the x402 payment requirements without charging. Use POST with X-PAYMENT header to scrape.

402.description: Payment required — inspect accepts[] for payment options
